# BB-MAP-001: Busy Bee System Map Doctrine

**Directive ID:** BB-MAP-001  
**Status:** Active  
**System:** Busy Bee Life Operating System  
**Infrastructure:** PSIP (Personal Strategic Intelligence Platform)  
**Type:** Structural Reference Directive

---

## 1. Purpose

This directive establishes the canonical System Map of Busy Bee - the complete structural reference showing all domains, agents, officers, and their interactions.

This map serves as:
- Contributor onboarding reference
- Directive coordination tool
- Architecture boundary documentation
- Cross-domain interaction guide

## 3. Domain: FINANCE

### Chief Officer
**Title:** Chief Financial Officer (CFO)  
**Role:** Synthesize financial intelligence, manage capital allocation strategy

### Specialist Agents

| Agent | Role | Purpose |
|-------|------|---------|
| Financial Planner | Strategist | Budgeting, saving strategies |
| Investment Strategist | Strategist | Investment recommendations |
| Risk Governor | Governor | Financial risk management |
| Portfolio Architect | Strategist | Portfolio construction |
| Macro Analyst | Observer | Economic monitoring |
| Options Intelligence | Strategist | Alternative investments |

### Cross-Domain
- -> Health: Investment returns fund health programs
- -> Career: Financial stability enables career risk-taking
